## Commercial / Promotional Disclosure (Required)

Does this contribution or link do any of the following? Tick all that apply.

- [ ] None - non-commercial, no promotional intent.
- [ ] Marketing - lead generation, self-promotion, affiliate/referral links, signup or email capture, or a repo that drives users to a product, service, or business that earns money.
- [ ] Paid service - requires payment, a subscription, or keeps core features behind a paid plan. This includes open source projects that offer a paid hosted, cloud, enterprise, or support plan.
- [ ] Sponsor tier - the link points to a sponsorship, donation, or paid-tier page.
- [ ] Other (define below)

## Payment Requirement (Required)

Select one option:

- [ ] Fully open source with no marketing and no paid offering - no payment required.
- [ ] Open source that does marketing or earns money (lead generation, self-promotion, funnel to a product or business, hosted/cloud version, paid tier, enterprise edition, paid support, etc.) - $1 monthly payment or $12 yearly payment.
- [ ] Service or closed source - $1 monthly payment or $12 yearly payment.

Note on paid listings:
We support open source and list open source projects for free. If a project, open source or not, does marketing or earns money through its listing (lead generation, self-promotion, a paid service, a paid tier, etc.), the listing is promotion and counts as a commercial placement. Commercial placements require a payment of $1/month or $12/year, which covers review and ongoing maintenance of the listing. If you ticked anything other than "None" under "Commercial / Promotional Disclosure", you must choose a paid option here.

Payment link: https://github.com/sponsors/hmert
